3.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
3.notes:
You always have certain spells prepared according to the Oath of Vengeance table.

3rd: Bane, Hunter's Mark
5th: Hold Person, Misty Step
9th: Haste, Protection from Energy
13th: Banishment, Dimension Door
17th: Hold Monster, Scrying

3.name: Vow of Enmity
3.notes:
When you take the Attack action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to choose a creature within 30 feet. You have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.

If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you may transfer the vow to another creature within 30 feet (no action required).

7.name: Relentless Avenger
7.notes: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn. You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction, and this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

15.name: Soul of Vengeance
15.notes: When a creature affected by your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack, you may use a Reaction to make a melee attack against it if it is within range.

20.name: Avenging Angel
20.notes:
As a Bonus Action, you gain the following benefits for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Usable once per Long Rest or restored by expending a level 5 spell slot.

Flight. Spectral wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet, and you can hover.

Frightful Aura. Enemies that start their turn in your Aura of Protection must make a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened for 1 minute or until they take damage. Attack rolls against Frightened creatures have Advantage.
